_derivation.note: The GSC searchanalytics.query API is small and fully enumerable: 4 response metrics (clicks, impressions, ctr, position/average_position) + 7 grouping dimensions (query, page, country, device, date, searchAppearance, hour) + 1 request-param surface dimension (type/search_type). All are declared in official_fields.json. The Supermetrics catalog (10 metrics / 73 dimensions) adds computed enrichments not available from the raw API: branded/non-branded classification, landing page tag extraction, URL parsing, SERP-position rounding, and system metadata — all enrichment_only. CTR is excluded from raw storage (AD-4 ratio rule; computed at the semantic layer from clicks/impressions).
_derivation.enrichment_only_estimate: Most of the 73 Supermetrics dimensions are computed (landing page HTML analysis, URL parsing, branded/non-branded, SERP grouping). Raw GSC dimensions are 8 (this catalog).

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/google-search-console-fields.md -o server/modules/gsc/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: GSC searchAnalytics.query selects only DIMENSIONS in the request body (the four metrics -- clicks, impressions, ctr, position -- always come back together). The probe issues one 1-row window per dimension field; metric fields are ratified as a group by presence in the response rows.

excluded_fields.ctr: Ratio metric computed at the semantic layer (AD-4); never stored raw.
excluded_fields.hour: Requires dataState=hourly_all which changes the data contract; ad-hoc only, excluded from catalog_daily.
